about: [O6] A car burnt to the wreck (brief O6 §2, §4): at the bed, across the road from the parked sedan, the Tommy gun into its bonnet until it burns (steam, smoke, then fire: flames at its seams, black smoke), then back off (S) and watch: the blast (the flash, the push - what stands near goes over), the wreck (a burnt body on its rims, the fire on it). Never too near: I am not hurt to the fall. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6_burn.json

steps.label: the sedan shot to fire, then the blast and the wreck, me standing
